result.summary: This residential intersection features continuous sidewalks but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control signs. The presence of parked vehicles near the corners creates potential sightline obstructions for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space or priority for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corners can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all four corners to ensure accessibility for all users.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control signage. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked vehicles near the corners create an environment where pedestrians must negotiate crossings without designated protection or clear sightlines.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated or protected space to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle movement at this four-way junction.
hazards.location_in_image: All corners of the visible intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection corners may obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both the left and right sides of the image near the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate traffic flow and provide predictable gaps for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce crossing distance, improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility for all users.
